question: A batsman's average runs in 23 matches is 41 and in the next 10 matches he scored at an average of 14 runs. What is his average runs (rounded to two decimal places) in a total of 33 matches?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Deviation of the 10 matches from the initial average = 14 − 41 = −27

Total deviation for 10 matches = 10 × (−27) = −270

This total deviation is distributed equally among all 33 matches.

Net change in average = −270 ÷ 33 ≈ −8.18

New average = 41 − 8.18 = 32.82

**∴ The correct answer is 32.82 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average runs in the first 23 matches = 41

Average runs in the next 10 matches = 14

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 
 
 
• 
 23 Matches (Avg 41)
 10 Matches (Avg 14)
 Combined Average ≈ 32.82
 Runs = 41
 Runs = 14

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total runs in the first 23 matches = 23 × 41 = 943

⇒ Total runs in the next 10 matches = 10 × 14 = 140

⇒ Total runs in all 33 matches = 943 + 140 = 1083

⇒ Total number of matches = 23 + 10 = 33

⇒ Combined Average = 1083 ÷ 33

⇒ Combined Average = 32.8181...

⇒ Rounding to two decimal places, Combined Average ≈ 32.82

**∴ The correct answer is 32.82 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When groups of different sizes are combined, the overall average is calculated using the formula: (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Deviation Method

A shortcut technique used to find the combined average quickly by assuming a base average and calculating the net deviation distributed uniformly over the total count.

Arithmetic Mean

It is defined as the sum of a collection of values divided by the total count of values in that collection.
